title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an implementation plan for the transition to a biennial budget cycle, and a preliminary multi-year fiscal…
text:
[Council File 26-1614]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an implementation plan for the transition to a biennial budget cycle, and a preliminary multi-year fiscal outlook covering Fiscal Years (FY) through 2029-30.
Recommendations for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Yaroslavsky, Hernandez - Harris-Dawson):
1. INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO) to present a report within 30 days to the City Council with an implementation plan for the transition to a biennial budget cycle, consistent with Council file No. 23-1027-S3, that includes the following elements:
a. A proposed timeline for the development of the four-year strategic plan to be prepared by the Mayor for City Council consideration.
b. Resources required to develop the four-year strategic plan that includes a public engagement component.
c. A proposed timeline for the transition to a biennial budget cycle following the adoption of multi-year Capital Infrastructure Plan (CIP) and a four-year strategic plan.
d. A preliminary needs assessment of the City's financial systems to determine the requirements necessary to produce a two-year budget and all required financial documents.
e. An estimate of the resources needed in FY 2027-28, to begin this transition.
f. Recommendations to inform the development of the CIP Ordinance.
2. INSTRUCT the CAO to present a report with a preliminary multi-year fiscal outlook to the City Council within 30 days covering FYs through 2029-30 that includes the following elements:
a. An economic forecast based on current economic conditions and assumptions derived from an analysis of the United States, state, and local economies.
b. A revised Budget Outlook scenario with revenue and expenditure projections based on trends in existing revenue streams to illustrate the level of available resources given current policy and projected economic assumptions and estimate of future costs of current services, adjusted for inflation and known obligations (such as collective bargaining increases or lease escalations).
c. An analysis of any identified projected annual deficits or surplus.
d. Estimated costs over the next 20 to 30 years for the City to meet its basic public right-of-way infrastructure needs, including for street lights, curb ramps, sidewalks, streets, urban forest, and compliance with the Healthy Streets L.A. measure.
e. Recommendations to improve the City's long-term fiscal condition, including the actions necessary to improve the City's finances.
3. REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present an Ordinance for an interim one-year budget pursuant to the passing of Charter Amendment LA.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Directs the CAO to report on a plan to move the city to a two-year budget and on a fiscal outlook through 2029-30, and asks the City Attorney to draft an interim one-year budget ordinance.
